name: Logitech X56 HOTAS
description: The light of the Logitech (Saitek) X56 Rhino HOTAS joystick and throttle (vendor 0x0738), one colour each. Adapted from OpenRGB's LogitechX56Controller (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. OpenRGB's manual save command is never sent. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/logitech-x56.md.
